caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical drum with a red rim on the top and bottom and a beige or tan body encircled by rope tensioning. The sides of the drum feature an elaborate painted design. At the center of the design is a large bald eagle with its wings spread wide and head facing to the right. The eagle clutches a bundle of arrows in its left talon and an olive branch in its right talon. Its chest is covered by a shield with a blue top and red and white vertical stripes on the lower part. Above the eagle’s head is a golden, radiating fan shape resembling stylized feathers, and behind the eagle is a blue field decorated with white stars. A red scroll-like banner runs across the eagle’s wings and above the shield, inscribed with the text: "9th INFANTRY." The background behind the eagle is teal or blue-green. The drum is shown with ropes looped vertically, secured by leather tabs, which serve both as decoration and tensioning apparatus. The overall composition is symmetrical and centered, with the drum being the sole object depicted, set against a plain, off-white background. The artist's signature, "WAYNE WHITE," appears in small print near the bottom left of the drum, and there is a number and a note written in the lower right in black ink.
title: Civil War Drum
